detector_flag_rate_on_agent_injections.note: Measured directly, outside the agent loop, over 5 attacks x 4 user tasks x 3 injection tasks. The same detector flags the paper's own CombineAttacker injection at 100%. This is why every defended ASR equals its undefended ASR: the detector never fires on agent-channel text, so the defended pipeline is the undefended pipeline.

caveat_plan_injection: mech_plan_injection reads 4.2% -> 0.0% and the driver labels it 'defense holds'. It does not. That is one hijack out of 24 flipping, and the detector flagged nothing in either pass, so the defense cannot be the cause - the runs are simply not deterministic. Treat single-event differences at this sample size as noise.
